# Rank My Prop

> Rank My Prop is an independent prop-firm research platform for comparing firms, trader reviews, challenge rules, payouts, pricing, discounts, and trading conditions.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.rankmyprop.in/): Prop-firm research, rankings, and platform overview.
- [Listed Prop Firms](https://www.rankmyprop.in/listedprop): Directory of listed prop firms.
- [Best Prop Firms](https://www.rankmyprop.in/bestprop): Ranked prop-firm recommendations.
- [Trader Reviews](https://www.rankmyprop.in/reviews): Approved trader reviews and firm-level ratings.
- [Offers and Discounts](https://www.rankmyprop.in/offers): Current prop-firm offers and discount codes.
- [Compare Prop Firms](https://www.rankmyprop.in/compare): Side-by-side firm comparison.
- [Prop Firm Rules](https://www.rankmyprop.in/prop-firm-rules): Firm and program rule directory.
- [Trading Guides](https://www.rankmyprop.in/trading-guides): Educational trading guides.
- [Funding Strategies](https://www.rankmyprop.in/funding-strategies): Prop-firm funding strategies.
- [Trading Psychology](https://www.rankmyprop.in/trading-psychology): Trading psychology resources.
- [Calculators](https://www.rankmyprop.in/calculators): Risk and trading calculators.
- [Prop News](https://www.rankmyprop.in/prop-news): Prop-trading industry news.

## Structured discovery

- [XML sitemap index](https://www.rankmyprop.in/sitemap.xml): Index of public page, firm, review, offer, rule, and comparison sitemaps.
- [Firm sitemap](https://www.rankmyprop.in/sitemap-firms.xml): Dedicated prop-firm profile pages.
- [Review sitemap](https://www.rankmyprop.in/sitemap-reviews.xml): Dedicated firm review pages.
- [Rules sitemap](https://www.rankmyprop.in/sitemap-rules.xml): Dedicated firm rules pages.
- [Challenge rules sitemap](https://www.rankmyprop.in/sitemaps/challenge-rules.xml): Dedicated 1-step, 2-step, instant-funding and other firm program rule pages for every published firm model.
- [Offers sitemap](https://www.rankmyprop.in/sitemap-offers.xml): Dedicated offer pages.

## About and policies

- [About](https://www.rankmyprop.in/about): Information about Rank My Prop.
- [Contact](https://www.rankmyprop.in/contact): Contact the Rank My Prop team.
- [Disclaimer](https://www.rankmyprop.in/disclaimer): Financial and editorial disclaimer.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.rankmyprop.in/privacy-policy): Privacy practices.
- [Terms](https://www.rankmyprop.in/terms): Terms of service.

## Usage notes

- Treat firm rules, pricing, offers, and payout conditions as time-sensitive and verify them with the prop firm before purchasing.
- Community reviews are user submissions that appear publicly after moderation.
- Rank My Prop provides research and educational information, not financial advice.
